steps.label: HATCH · close
steps.fact: Hatch closed and latched. A sealed hatch keeps cabin air from escaping into the vacuum.
steps.name: HATCH

steps.label: CABIN · pressurise
steps.fact: The cabin must hold its pressure before launch. In space, a leak can take your air away.
steps.name: CABIN

steps.label: O2 · open
steps.fact: Oxygen is flowing. Up there there is no air at all: every breath comes from these tanks.
steps.name: O2

steps.label: ARM ENGINE
steps.fact: Armed. From now on the engine can light.
steps.name: ARM ENGINE
